assets.name: 阳光云平台

function_relationships.rationale: Logger5000通过IEC104协议北向转发数据至阳光云平台（FACT-002, FACT-019）
Logger5000通过Modbus协议北向转发数据至阳光云平台（FACT-002, FACT-019）
Logger5000通过MQTT协议北向转发数据至阳光云平台（FACT-002, FACT-019）
Logger5000通过GOOSE协议北向转发数据至阳光云平台（FACT-002, FACT-019）
Logger5000通过4G路由器将设备数据直接传输至阳光云平台（FACT-005）

assets.description: 由阳光电源运营的远程云服务平台，接收并处理EMU300A上传的运行数据、日志及遥测信息，提供监控、分析与远程维护能力；其服务可用性、数据完整性及通信机密性直接影响EMU300A的远程功能实现。
assets.value: 支撑能量管理单元的远程监控、故障诊断、功率调度优化及合规数据上报；若服务不可用或遭篡改，将导致本地控制降级、运维中断、数据丢失及电网调度指令延迟/失效。

related_objectives.description: 确保EMU300A与阳光云平台之间传输的数据在传输过程中不被未授权访问或窃取。

evidence.quote:
数据采集器将数据转发至阳光云平台的功能默认不可用。启用该功能前，客户需在充
分知情的前提下进行手动授权，并通过安全加密认证接入公共网络。远程访问仅在获
得客户授权后方可生效，且相关操作受系统访问控制策略管理。
evidence.notes: 系统已用规范文本块原文补全来源上下文；审阅时仍需确认该原文是否支持具体结论。

related_objectives.description: 确保EMU300A向阳光云平台上传的数据在传输过程中不被篡改或注入伪造内容。

evidence.quote:

result.notes: hardware_and_network field failed with technical_failure; no hardware/network assets can be confirmed from facts. Only external services with direct evidence (FACT-001–020) are included. RS485/MPLC/IEC104/Modbus/MQTT/GOOSE interfaces are communication protocols or logical functions — not standalone hardware/network assets per rules. Core switch, Insight, SCADA, station control system, inverters, transformers, environmental monitors and meters are listed in integrated_systems but lack explicit evidence of being *externally affected* (e.g., no fact states ‘EMU300A transmits to SCADA’); thus excluded per rule #3 (no guessing). All candidate services requiring confirmation (e.g., NTP server) are marked needs_confirmation. No conditional hardware (e.g., MPLC, fiber switch) is included because field_batches.facts for hardware_and_network is empty — only external_services facts are available and usable.
